title: The thinking and decision loop
description: Name the outcome, investigate the important unknown, build a small result, and judge it using evidence. Record the decision when the acceptance conditions are met. If effort is exhausted or progress needs unavailable input, record the partial result and blocker.

title: What information goes where
description: The brief supplies intent; relevant files and documentation supply facts; an optional skill supplies a procedure. Tools change artifacts, and review returns evidence to the next decision.

title: Choose the help you actually need
description: Clarify an unclear outcome, connect a missing tool, reuse existing procedural guidance, and consider a hook only for a repeatable event action.

title: Improve one cause at a time
description: Preserve a baseline and failing scenario. Change the rule, code, design, or workflow responsible. Compare the same scenario and retain only improvements that survive review. Stop at the effort limit and preserve the best verified baseline.

title: Choose a video workflow
description: Use composition and real captures for exact text and gameplay; use a generation model for imagined footage. Add orchestration when the process repeats across jobs.

title: A trailer’s data flow
description: A brief becomes a shot manifest. Captured or generated clips are reviewed, assembled with titles and sound, then exported. Job records connect source assets and parameters to the final file.

title: Inside a video node graph
description: Conceptual stages only, not literal node names or an importable ComfyUI graph. Compatible model components, prompt conditioning, and optional reference frames feed generation and decoding before saving a video.

title: Submit once, track the job, inspect the output
description: Keep the task ID through pending, running, and throttled states. Retry transient status errors within a deadline; reconcile uncertain submissions. A local timeout does not cancel the remote job. Save and review successful output.

title: Use a hook for a narrow local check
description: A relevant tool event can trigger a local validator. An irrelevant event exits immediately. This proposed pattern does not generate a video or publish anything by itself.
